id.description: A unique value identifying this person. Accepts both numeric ID and UUID.

key.description: The property key to set. Pair it with 'value' to set one property.

properties.description: Property keys and values to set together, instead of 'key' and 'value'. One request sets up to 1000 properties and emits a single $set event.

value.description: The property value. Can be a string, number, boolean, or object.
